Check a Project Against the rProject Standard

Source: R/rProject-conform.R
Conform.Rd

Compares a project with the rProject standard and returns what differs as a data frame (and prints it as a table). The checks reuse rProject's own rules: the manifest and the folders of the project's type (inst/template/manifest.tsv, folders.tsv, Tree()), the file set of a finished reference project, the stray files Overleaf leaves (main.tex, .tmp-r/), the files every package has but the manifest does not keep (vignettes/.gitignore, inst/CITATION, tests/testthat.R, .setup/pkgdown/_pkgdown.yml), the test file of each export (test-<pkg>-<name>.R, as make lint names it), the file names and one function per file (locked copies from .setup/r-dependencies/ and .setup/cpp/ are exempt), lint_error <- FALSE, the missing rproject.lock, and .setup/repo/ (placeholder text, repository name, Overleaf URL). A .gitignore that Overleaf renamed to gitignore is accepted. A finding that the reference has too is not reported.

Usage

Conform(
  path = ".",
  reference = NULL,
  remote = FALSE,
  lint = FALSE,
  tests = FALSE,
  log_dir = tempdir()
)

Arguments

path

Character string. The project folder.

reference

Character string or NULL. The folder of a finished project to compare the file set with. With NULL, only the manifest and the rules are used.

remote

Logical. If TRUE, also ask GitHub (git ls-remote, read-only) whether the private repository named in .setup/repo/ exists, and compare the origin of the clone. Skipped quietly without git, ssh, or a network.

lint

Logical. If TRUE, run the project's make lint and report its findings.

tests

Logical. If TRUE, run devtools::test() and report its failures and counts.

log_dir

Character string. The folder for the raw outputs of make lint and the tests (conform-lint.log, conform-tests.log); a temporary folder by default.

Value

Returns a data frame, invisibly, with the columns rule, class ("fix", "decide", or "info"), file, message, and fix (how ConformFix() fixes a fix row). The attribute logs names the saved outputs of lint and tests.

Details

Each finding has a class: fix (safe; ConformFix() writes or removes it), decide (ambiguous: the user decides), and info (expected, for example before the first release). With lint = TRUE, it also runs the project's real make lint (which runs make style first: files may change, read them again) and, with tests = TRUE, devtools::test() with NOT_CRAN=true, both in the R that runs Conform() (no Apptainer call), and reports each house row, each style: or warning: message of lintr, and each test failure or error as a decide row (rule lint or tests). The counts of the tests are always a row. The raw outputs are saved in log_dir and the paths are printed. Nothing else is changed.

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
Conform(path = getwd())
Conform(path = getwd(), reference = "../devel-linearAlgebra")
Conform(path = getwd(), lint = TRUE, tests = TRUE)
} # }
